reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-07'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
  AND ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur
alternatives:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur) AS n_lines
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-07'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE store_code = 'BE-07') AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' AND ol.unit_price_eur / p.unit_cost_eur > 10
